versions.summary: Initial product doc
Refocus on human-triggered REST feedback; retire AI-agent MCP capture
Free multi-tenant SaaS core: accounts, tenants, projects, per-project credentials; no billing
P3: feedback is project-scoped; add project-scoped Feedback API v2 (read+manage), cross-project search, and operational usage monitoring (no billing); flip the broad-public-REST-management non-goal
P7: agent-decided write-only feedback capture returns as an MCP surface (agents linked to a project's /mcp save feedback with the project's vk_ key); three read tools stay retired
P4: the authenticated web app is vocky's primary user surface (tenant dashboard, project detail, cross-project feedback search), superseding the packaged operator Admin Web UI
P5: the vocky CLI is a first-class user surface alongside the web app — the whole accounts to key to capture to read spine is completable from the terminal without visiting the website
P6: the packaged Admin Web UI is retired for real; vocky is deploy-ready but not deployed (launch is P12) and the CLI is packaged but unpublished (distribution is P11)
P10: the accounts plane is user/org/project — signup lands a ready-to-use account with a default project, and a key is now a user's choice between one project and the whole org
P11: distribution is a curl bash installer not PyPI, and vocky ships a published agent-skill surface with three capture paths behind two environment variables
Initial experience doc
REST-only capture flow; remove MCP capture-surface choice and liked-conversation MCP tool
Integrate via signup then create project then mint vk_ credential; send it as Authorization: Bearer on /api/*; replace optional-static-token guidance
P3: read+manage your project's feedback via vk_ key on /api/project/feedback; search across your projects via session on /app/feedback (Korean); view usage via /app/usage
P7: agents capture feedback via the write-only capture_feedback MCP tool at a project's /mcp endpoint, authed by the project's vk_ key
P4: the vocky web app — sign up in the browser, tenant dashboard, project drill-down with show-once key mint/revoke, and cross-project Korean-safe feedback search/read
P9: the public landing now serves / to signed-out visitors (signed-in bounce to /dashboard preserved) as a real product surface

P5: the vocky CLI onboarding journey — signup to project to key to capture to read from the terminal (headless --password-stdin, --base-url, VOCKY_CONFIG_DIR, generic-401, show-once key); docs/cli.md is the full reference
P6: the install story is packaged but unpublished — lean pip install vocky vs vocky[server], and vocky.hi2vi.com is not live yet
P10: onboarding is two steps not three (signup provisions a default project), a key is a scope choice between project and org, and project names are unique per org
P11: onboarding is real end to end for an agent — a curl bash install line, VOCKY_API_TOKEN plus vocky capture as the two-variable contract, and a published vocky-feedback skill
Initial architecture doc
Retire MCP track; REST-only two-track API (public REST + Admin REST)
Add identity + tenancy layer; /auth + /app control-plane; mandatory per-project credential auth on /api
P3: feedback project scoping, ingest-scope threading, pg_trgm substring search subsystem, derived usage
P7: revive MCP as a write-only capture surface (/mcp mount + session_manager lifespan) feeding the shared queue; MCP env in Configuration Surface

P4: the web/ Next.js app + server-side BFF as vocky's browser surface (sealed httpOnly cookie, no CORS, no web-side DB); admin-UI convergence resolved — replacement built in P4, physical removal deferred to P6

P5: the vocky CLI as a new pure-client surface over /auth/* + /app/* (Typer app in src/vocky/cli/, no backend change), mirroring the web-app client framing; server console entry renamed to vocky-server

P6: the packaged Admin Web UI is physically removed (only /admin/api/* survives) and the production deployment topology lands — five containers on the shared edge network, worker reusing the api image
P10: user/org/project accounts plane — the ingest middleware resolves a credential's project scope once per request as a non-null tuple, and enqueue is the write path's last enforcement point
Initial frontend doc
P4: the vocky web app — Next.js 16 app in web/, ported Tailwind-v4 design system, server-side BFF + sealed-cookie session, and the dashboard/project/feedback page inventory
P8: drop the deleted web/design/canvas section; design gate closed at P8, applied by P9 (not deferred to P6); placeholder state stays live
P9: apply the round-01 vocky design across the app and landing — deep-emerald value swap, Pretendard, new component vocabulary, net-new states, public / landing; placeholder retired

P6: the site metadata/OG/robots/sitemap/manifest routes, the NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL build-time origin, the prod-gated CSP, and the standalone production image; the replaced Admin Web UI is now actually deleted
P10: the dashboard gains an org-keys panel, VockyCredential.project_id widens to string|null, the show-once key panel becomes a shared component, and Workspace becomes Org

P11: the landing gains an agent quickstart and a skill section, the Snippet and Trap primitives, mount-gated copy islands over a server-rendered no-JS floor, and a request-time read of the served skill file
Initial backend doc
Accounts domain package, require_user/AuthContext/AuthError guard, security primitives, and auth_api/app_api route modules
P7: mcp_server.py FastMCP bootstrap, capture_feedback tool module, is_mcp_path broadened ingest guard, McpCaptureFeedbackInput
P6: create_app no longer registers admin_ui_routes — the Admin Web UI module and its assets are deleted; middleware and the /admin/api routes are unchanged

P10: accounts gains provision_signup, get_or_create_project, get_project_by_name, list_org_credentials and get_credential; auth gains the credential project-scope resolver; capture gains resolve_capture_project
Initial data doc
Accounts and tenancy schema: users, tenants, tenant_members, projects, project_credentials, auth_tokens (migration 20260715_1200)
P3: feedback_events.project_id FK+index (migration 20260716_1500), pg_trgm trigram GIN search index (20260716_1600, head); credential/auth-token last_used_at now stamped
P10: migration 20260728_1200 — projects UNIQUE(tenant_id,name) with an oldest-wins de-dupe, project_credentials.tenant_id NOT NULL, and project_id nullable (IS NULL = org-level)
Initial api doc
Retire MCP/agent-capture; REST-only feedback surface
Add account auth (/auth), tenant/project/credential control-plane (/app), and mandatory per-project credential auth on /api
P3 Feedback API v2: project-scoped read+manage, cross-project read+search, usage endpoints

P7: add write-only capture_feedback MCP tool contract (flat inputs, source nested, no attachment_ids; capture receipt) and the /mcp per-project vk_ credential auth model; un-retire MCP as a write-only surface
P4: correct the stale Admin-Docs-try-it forward reference — P4 superseded the packaged operator UI with the web app rather than updating its docs; removal moves to P6 (no API contract change)
P6: the packaged Admin Web UI routes are deleted — /admin and /admin/assets/* no longer exist, only the bearer-guarded /admin/api/* REST surface remains, and it is 404d at the production edge

P10: signup returns an additive project, POST /app/projects is get-or-create, three new org-level /app/credentials routes, credential project_id is nullable, and capture takes an optional project name honored only for org keys
Initial operations doc
P4: web app build/run (pnpm dev on :3030, output standalone) and its two server-only env keys; production deploy remains P6

P5: the vocky-server server-entry rename and vocky CLI install (uv tool install / uvx / in-repo uv run vocky; PyPI publish is P6) with its ~/.config/vocky/config.json (0700/0600, VOCKY_CONFIG_DIR) session store
P6: the vocky.hi2vi.com production deploy kit — compose topology, box secrets, web image, edge vhost, deploy/rollback runbook, CI chain, lean-CLI split; authored + statically validated, NOT deployed
P11: the hosted install.sh installer, the repo's first push and pull-request CI gate with its two deliberate exclusions, and the CLI capture module
Initial security doc
Argon2id passwords, opaque hashed session tokens (30-day TTL), mint-once hashed vk_ project credentials, mandatory ingest auth, no enumeration

P3: project-scoped read authz (404-never-403 on /api/project/* and /app/feedback), one vk_ key captures+reads+manages its project (no per-credential scopes), best-effort last_used_at stamping, tightened project-scoped self-read
P7: /mcp requires a per-project vk_ credential (same guard/401/last_used_at as /api/*); DNS-rebinding on; static token retired

P4: the web app's browser credential — AES-256-GCM sealed httpOnly session cookie via the BFF (token never in browser JS), rate-limited public auth routes, the show-once vk_ key crossing, and forced attachment download

P5: the CLI's on-disk 30-day session token at ~/.config/vocky/config.json (0600) — the first filesystem-resident vocky session credential; the CLI holds the session token and mints vk_ keys for /api/*

P6: the production edge/app security split — prod-gated app CSP, edge HSTS + additive upgrade-insecure-requests, Cloudflare real-IP restore, /admin 404 internal-only at the edge, and the unthrottled /auth/* origin gap (D5)

P10: org-level vk_ keys are a real trust-boundary widening — key scope is now user-chosen (project-bound or org-level) and the guarantee is anchored on tenancy plus a middleware-resolved non-null project-id tuple
Initial qa doc
Initial decisions doc
P2 auth-model and tenancy-shape decisions: email/password + opaque DB tokens, multi-tenant solo-owner, /app vs /api split, mandatory ingest auth
Record P3 feedback-API-v2 decisions: project scope on feedback, /api/project + /app read-manage split, pg_trgm Korean-safe substring search, derived usage no metering, tightened self-read
P7 MCP-revival decisions: write-only scope, broadened-middleware auth binding, thin McpCaptureFeedbackInput, transport security on
P4 web-app decisions: app in a repo subdir web/, server-side BFF + sealed httpOnly cookie (no CORS, no web-side DB), port the design system and defer the heavy design gate to P6
P8: add D-P8-1 (round 01 design gate closed) superseding D-P4-3; the landing design+build moves to P8+P9

P10: add D-P10-1..5 — no tenants-to-orgs rename, a default project but a friendly org name, one vk_ prefix for both scopes, omitting --project mints an org key, and no design round for the org-key surface
